name: Queen's Love
overview: An upcoming, global GL production announced by Lumina Entertainment. While the studio launched its official casting calls and character reveals (introducing roles like Princess Victoria, Crystal, and Cocoa), its formal premiere is slated for 2027. The series features a royal and high-society backdrop. Initial character teasers include Princess Victoria (the royal heir to the throne), Cocoa (the prime minister's daughter), and a famous actress named Crystal
